Third-party programs in this archive
====================================

libris is a separate work. This archive also redistributes programs libris runs
in order to read a PDF, together with the libraries those programs were built
against. They are redistributed under the terms they were published under, and
the full text of every one of those licenses is in `tools/share/licenses`
beside this file.

  pdftotext, pdftoppm, libpoppler
      GPL-2.0-or-later or MIT, at the upstream's option. See poppler's own
      COPYING and LICENSE in the folder named above.

  poppler-data
      GPL-2.0-or-later, BSD-3-Clause and MIT parts. The CMaps and CID tables a
      Chinese or Japanese text layer is decoded with.

  fontconfig, freetype, libpng, zlib, bzip2, expat, pcre2, cairo, pixman,
  libjpeg-turbo, openjpeg, lcms2, harfbuzz, glib2, graphite2, nspr, nss
      Permissive licenses: MIT, BSD-style, the zlib license, and the FTL for
      FreeType. Each folder sits beside its own copy.

The versions shipped are the ones the build machine's package manager offered on
the day the archive was made. Source for each is obtainable from its upstream:
poppler at https://poppler.freedesktop.org, and the rest from the distribution
named on this release's page.

Nothing here is a license grant by libris's authors over anybody else's work.
